customer: Hi, so I'm a college student here in Virginia and I've got this coupe that I honestly barely drive anymore since I mostly walk or bike to campus, and between insurance and parking passes it's kind of draining my wallet. I was thinking about just selling it to you, but I don't really need another car right now, so do I have to buy something from you to be able to sell it? Also, would I get a worse offer if I'm not buying anything?
agent: Thanks for reaching out! No, you don't need to buy a car from us to sell us your coupe, and the offer is the same whether you buy from us or not. If you ever decide you do want to buy, you can use the sale as a trade-in on your purchase, and our article Trading in vs. selling outright explains how sales tax can differ between the two.
